promise.how: read the artefact itself -- the page text from the node that produced it -- and emit no row when it is empty (*Content Log Row* does exactly this: no article_html and no page_markdown means 'report only')
promise.why: D10 / R1: a row saying a page was written while no page was written is read by the ladder plan, the Rank Tracker and the Content Cadence as a page that exists -- the cadence paused itself on pages nobody had

reversal.how: keep a node that writes the row back to `planned` with its reason in `status_note` (*Refused Ladder Row*)
reversal.why: R1: the budget guard refused execution 500 and row 19 stayed "writing", so within 90 seconds the ladder plan promised the page, the Rank Tracker said "already written -- publish it" and the cadence counted it among the pages waiting for publication and paused itself. fix_phantom_pages.py exists because of this.
writers: SEO Agent v4 — Audit, Keywords, Verdict & Content / Refused Ladder Row

reversal.how: keep a node that writes the row back to `queued` with its reason in `reason` (*AI Target Marks*, when the content run could not be started), and settle the forward state against the evidence (*AI Target Settle*)
reversal.why: B9-6: the Content Cadence marked an AI target `writing` and stamped `written_at` the moment it STARTED a page run, and nothing ever wrote the row forward or back -- so a refused or failed run left the question claiming work in progress for ever and it was never queued again. R1's class, in the one table R1 did not cover.
writers: SEO Agent — Content Cadence / AI Target Marks

verdict.how: set every one of those fields when the gate refuses (v5/code/Originality_Check.js does it), never only the flag
verdict.why: B3-3: the originality gate ran AFTER *Content QA* had finalised the delivery gate and set only `qa.passed`, so a draft 100% identical to a competitor page came out `publishable: true`, `not_ready: false`, "passed the quality check" -- which is what the -DRAFT file name, the package banner, meta.json, the callback and the app all read. A gate that fails is a refusal, not a label.
